That is a build-then-test workflow. KICKOFF step 8 mandates the opposite for any track that loads this skill: write the failing test first, then implement to green, under the test-driven-development skill. I grepped the full references/ chain (models-orm.md, drf-serializers.md, viewsets-views.md, authentication.md, testing-django.md) for test-first/TDD/red-green/write-test-before-code language and found none - testing-django.md is APITestCase/fixtures/factory recipes only, with no ordering guidance that would reconcile the two. A track subagent handed django-expert as its lane skill under the step-8 test-first mandate gets a lane reference whose own workflow instructs it to build first and test last, a genuine behavioral disagreement between the guide and the skill.
